text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road got hurt, so
I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for worrying you.
But there's really no need for concern!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Because I have this with me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
My dad used to tell me when I was little:
'A little scrape'll heal right up if ya just eat!'

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: In other words, it's all about mindset! You have to conquer the injury with heart first!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow away an injury like this in no time!
Now, let's get back to training!
choice_data_list: Still, I'm worried, so I want you to rest.
How about we eat and then get moving a bit?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
! I see, you're right.
Worrying you any further... I don't want that either...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll stay quiet and rest until my injury heals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she looked disappointed,
Narita Top Road devoted herself to treatment...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Let's head outside as soon as we finish eating!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Now, let's get all fired up—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed this wasn't an injury that could be
fixed with mere willpower...
They hurried back to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It looks like moving around
a little won't be a problem!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: My father's teachings are truly magnificent! Fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, her return to training
came sooner than expected!
